issues.text: Design section 5 says a wrong password at POST /api/account/deletion-request leaves audit_log unchanged. The code (routes/auth.js reauthFailure, the M2AUTH 4.9.5 rule of every re-auth failure) commits the counter of the user's row and one audit row auth.reauth_failed with reason wrong_password; a locked re-auth writes one too. DEL-3 asserts the code's behaviour (no deletion_requests row, no account.deletion_request audit row, exactly one auth.reauth_failed row, every other table unchanged). I take this for a loose line of the design table, not a product defect: REQ-116 c6 says only «refused, no row».

Design 7.1 c10 and 7.3 name the exception tests FW-8 and FW-9, but FW-8 already exists in forbidden-words.test.js (the module of the lists is the one file of app/ with a Kazakh form). The narrowness test is therefore FW-8b; FW-9 is unchanged. TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR should read FW-8b where the design says FW-8 (mutants W1-W3 of this report).

Not in this lane, by the two handoffs: M2R-1 (the pg race of ten parallel accepts) lives in pg/m2-race-pg.test.js, which the projects lane owns with M2R-2 and M2R-3, so INV-6 (PGlite) is the only accept race written here; M2P-3 (the consent box not ticked at load, the five consent elements empty) is in the projects lane's unit/m2-pages.test.js (present in the tree when this lane finished) and ACC-1/ACC-2 are the e2e of that lane. The files that both lanes could have claimed are named in the header of fixtures/m23.js: this lane edited auth-reauth, rate-limit, auth-session, logging, texts, forbidden-words and fixtures/auth.js; the guard edits of every other file (route-table incl. its PURPOSES literal of G2, isolation, permission-matrix, migrate, rls, npmrc, public-pages, public-build, vercel-build, security-invariants) are the projects lane's.

Behaviours the tests pin that the design leaves open or loose: routeTable(deps) has 27 rows (the two demo rows are added by the app, 29 in all), so INV-8 and INV-10 count 27; the app role has no UPDATE grant on org_members, so the move of OO-1 is refused at the privilege (42501) for sai_app and by the trigger (P0001) for the owner role; a plain invite planted into the owner organisation is a 500 at the accept (the trigger, no half account, the invite unspent) as design 4.5.1 step 11 says; an accept's returned refusals count the address (INV-7 relies on unknown codes counting).

No product defect was found: none of the new tests failed on fa32e0a for a reason in the code. The two accepted residuals of decisions/0138 Addition 1 (a purge setting settable by code that runs SQL as sai_app; an org_owner deleted from an organisation that keeps other members) are by design not tested.
